prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a simple polished 2D cartoon UI texture atlas for a cute chibi ninja mobile game with bright green garden backgrounds. EXACT regular 3 by 3 grid, 9 equal square tiles, no gaps. Flat clean digital cel colors, soft matte materials, thick simple dark brown outlines, very restrained warm yellow inner rim. NO metallic rendering, NO engraving, NO ornaments, NO decorative corners, NO realistic texture, NO glow, NO perspective, NO text. Each tile has rounded corners radius about 8% of its width; its central 80% is a completely uniform flat color suitable for nine-slice scaling. Row 1: muted deep plum main panel with simple warm tan rim; warm cream parchment panel with medium brown outline; jade green primary button with dark teal outline. Row 2: muted dusky purple secondary button with darker purple outline; warm apricot yellow selected button with brown outline; muted terracotta red cancel button with dark brown outline. Row 3: warm ivory collection card with muted golden brown outline; muted slate violet inset panel with subdued outline; sunny orange fever fill with simple yellow top highlight. Very slight two-tone shaded top edge only, no complex gradients. Background of rounded-corner cutout portions pure white or actual transparent alpha; all cells equal aligned and each complete tile fits its cell. Readable friendly mobile game UI matching cartoon sprites.

Use case: stylized-concept. A production icon atlas for a cute 2D CHIBI ninja merge mobile game. EXACT 4x4 equal grid, 16 icons, one per equal square cell with large 18% blank margins; no frames and no tile backgrounds. Clean simple flat CARTOON icon design with bold rounded dark-brown outlines, warm honey yellow gold, jade green, plum purple, cream highlights; 2 or 3 cel shades only, large clear shapes. NO realistic metallic reflections, NO ornate filigree, NO glow, NO texture, NO tiny details, NO ground shadows. Row1 left to right: simple rolled summoning scroll with tiny ninja head emblem; two crossed short ninja blades with one curved arrow; shopping pouch with coin emblem; open encyclopedia book with star tab. Row2: simple gold settings cog; gold coin stack; purple faceted gem; simple curled golden phoenix reincarnation symbol. Row3: three simple masked ninja heads population; rounded green mountain map marker; small reward television with white play triangle; bold cream X close with brown outline. Row4: simple bronze padlock; cartoon tapping finger with star; jade hourglass and sprout; two crossed short blades with small clock. Background actual transparent RGBA preferred, otherwise perfectly pure flat white. Never checkerboard. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, interface panels or scene. Uniform consistent icon sizes, icons do not touch edges or each other.
